title: Can I BEAT Thermopylae?
summary: 'Thermopylae' (Thermopoly): a 2-human-player puzzle variant on a chess.com 4-player board. Humans play Red (huge army of kings, queens, bishops and fairy pieces) and Green (small army with a General that survives 73 checks); Blue and Yellow are random bots that prefer giving checks. Red must capture Green's General; Green wins by having its General taken by a bot or by surviving 72 moves (Yellow's rook checks Red's trapped Ferz each move, and after 72 checks Red loses). He wins as both colours, opening as Red by sacrificing both queens to the blue bot.
rules: Board: chess.com 4-player cross with grey blocked regions; humans = Red and Green, Blue and Yellow = bots.
Bots move randomly but prefer any checking move.
Red wins only by capturing Green's General (General survives 73 checks).
Green wins by (1) losing its General to a bot's piece, or (2) surviving 72 moves - Yellow's rook checks Red's royal Ferz each turn; 72 checks = Red loses.

Pieces: Nightrider (knight repeated any distance in a line), Wildebeest (L-leap of (1,2) or (1,3)... 'L-shape of length two or three'), Archbishop (B+N), General (K+N), Sergeant (moves and captures forward and diagonally forward), Soldier (Green: moves and captures only forward), Ferz (one square diagonally; Red's is trapped in the corner and royal-ish for the 72-check counter).

Clock (chess.com): 2:00 per human with a 5-second DELAY, not an increment (16:35 'We have 5 seconds delay', 16:47 'in this variant, you get 5 seconds of delay', 25:47 'as long as I play within my 5-second delay'; 4:33 'down to 49 seconds' in game 1). Running out loses (22:17 he flags the 2200 opponent). Built cm_h5 2026-11-27: the player's clock only.
win_condition: Red: capture Green's General. Green: General captured by a bot, or survive 72 moves.
